title: Heavenly Eye Breaks Illusions, First Display of Might
next_chapter_hook: Just as Chen Ji turned to leave, the demonic shadows beside Ye Qing dissipated silently—she had already issued a secret order to investigate Chen Ji in the shadows. The three-day deadline—could it be Chen Ji's scheme, or Ye Qing's counter-hunt?

text.content: The eerie purple glow of the Demonic Path forbidden technique pulsed at Ye Qing's fingertips, merely three inches from Chen Ji's throat. That suffocating pressure felt tangible, warping all the air within several zhang around. Chen Ji clearly sensed the destructive power contained within that forbidden technique—just one instant, and he would be shattered into dust by this Demonic Path secret method.

dialogue.content: What, the useless disciple of Tianqing Sect, scared? Ye Qing's voice cut through the cold pool like an ice blade, her lips curving into a playful arc. She slowly retracted the forbidden technique's glow from her fingertips, yet didn't retreat a single step, instead closing in another stride, almost face to face with Chen Ji.

text.content: Three days later, at the core of the secret realm, a solo battle between us. Ye Qing's voice echoed through the empty ruins, carrying undeniable pressure. If you win, I'll hand over the list of Holy Sect's hidden agents planted among humans with both hands. If you lose... she deliberately paused, a dangerous light flickering in her eyes, the Tianji Record Fragment will be mine.

Chen Ji's heart lurched. The Tianji Record Fragment—she actually knows about this? This secret wasn't even known to the Tianqing Sect's Sect Master, yet Ye Qing spoke of it in a single phrase. Could it be that the Holy Sect's intelligence network has already penetrated to such an extent? Or does she and the Tianji Record have some unknown connection?

dialogue.content: Fine. Chen Ji's voice was so calm it didn't carry a single ripple, as if what Ye Qing proposed wasn't a life-or-death gamble but just an inconsequential sparring match. He slightly raised his head, and within those seemingly timid eyes, a sharp gleam flickered. I accept.

Oh? Ye Qing raised an eyebrow, clearly not expecting him to accept so readily. She thought she'd have to spend more breath threatening, yet this useless one actually showed some spine. Her gaze lingered on Chen Ji's face for a moment, seemingly trying to find a crack in his eyes, yet that face was as calm as an ancient well's deep pool, unruffled.

text.content: Just as Ye Qing's words fell, Chen Ji's pupils suddenly contracted. The Tianji Record mark at his brow center pulsed violently, an unprecedented burning sensation surging from the depths of his soul—that was the sign of the Heavenly Eye operating on its own! Chen Ji forcefully suppressed his astonishment and gathered his spiritual sense without batting an eye.

In an instant, the scene before Chen Ji's eyes underwent a dramatic transformation. The demonic energy around Ye Qing was no longer a chaotic purple-black, but became an intricate network diagram—the operational trajectory of the Demonic Path technique. And within those complex trajectories, a subtle crack was clearly visible.

That's the foundation of the Demonic Sacred Art! Chen Ji was elated in his heart. With the Heavenly Eye operating at full power, he not only saw through Ye Qing's demonic technique's operational patterns, but also glimpsed that fatal flaw—her demonic seed within wasn't an integrated whole, but forcibly fused by some external force. As long as he struck that fusion point...

dialogue.content: Three days later, at the core of the secret realm, I'll be waiting. Chen Ji withdrew his gaze, the corners of his mouth slightly rising, revealing a meaningful smile. That smile, falling in Ye Qing's eyes, inexplicably made her alert—why did this useless disciple's gaze become so sharp in an instant?

What are you looking at? Ye Qing's voice turned cold and sharp, the Demonic Path forbidden technique gathering again at her fingertips. She felt something was off—that moment just now, Chen Ji's gaze seemed to pierce through all her defenses, looking directly at the secret that should never be seen.

text.content: Nothing. Chen Ji casually looked away, yet his heart was already churning. The consumption of the Heavenly Eye operating at full power far exceeded anything before, his Heavenly Fate Value depleting visibly, but he had obtained the information he wanted—Ye Qing's demonic seed foundation had a fatal flaw, and its location was precisely three cun below her heart.

choice.prompt: In three days, you'll face Ye Qing in a decisive battle, with time running out. How do you plan to prepare within these three days?

choices.description: Devote all energy to cultivation within three days, striving to break through the current realm in the shortest time possible, overwhelming Ye Qing with absolute strength.
choices.visible_cost: Consume vast reserves of spirit stones and elixirs
choices.risk_hint: Whether breakthrough can be achieved within three days remains uncertain

text.content: Chen Ji turned and left, his steps steady. Ye Qing gazed at his retreating figure, a flicker of doubt crossing her eyes. That useless disciple's expression just now was too peculiar; that momentary sharpness was absolutely not something a menial servant should possess. She secretly issued an order: Go investigate, this useless disciple of Tianqing Sect—I want to know all his secrets.

choices.description: Deploy hidden chess pieces, collect secret treasures or techniques that counter the demonic seed's fusion point, gaining the greatest advantage with the smallest cost.
choices.visible_cost: Revealing some hidden pieces risks alerting the enemy
choices.visible_reward: Acquire key items that suppress the demonic seed
choices.risk_hint: External power, though formidable, becomes a vulnerability when overly relied upon.

text.content: After leaving Ye Qing's sight, Chen Ji immediately issued orders to the pieces hidden throughout various sects through secret channels. Soon, intelligence poured in—Demonic Path mist, Seed-Breaking Talismans, Demon-Suppressing Elixirs... He selected the most effective one from this information, a cold smile curling at the corner of his mouth.

choices.description: Based on the flaws revealed by Heavenly Eye, meticulously designing tactical traps. Using skill to overcome force, leading Ye Qing into a deadly ground without her knowledge.
choices.visible_cost: Requires meticulous calculation; one mistake means total defeat.
choices.visible_reward: Achieving complete victory without revealing one's trump card.
choices.risk_hint: Even the wisest may overlook a detail; success hinges on the minutiae.

text.content: Chen Ji found a secluded spot, sat cross-legged, and closed his eyes. The Heavenly Eye operated once more, rehearsing every detail of the duel three days hence in his mind a thousand times. Attack routes, retreat paths, Ye Qing's possible reactions... Every variable was precisely calculated.

Three days passed in an instant. When Chen Ji stepped into the secret realm's core area once more, he was greeted by Ye Qing's confident smile. The Holy Sect of the Demonic Path disciples had already set up barriers around them—this battle, regardless of victory or defeat, would shake the entire secret realm.

dialogue.content: I thought you'd dare not come. Ye Qing stood at the arena's center, demonic aura churning like a tide around her. She had changed into combat attire, her silver armor reflecting an eerie purple light under the demonic energy. In just three days, her cultivation seemed to have advanced once more—clearly, she hadn't wasted these three days either.

text.content: Chen Ji slowly entered the battlefield's center, his face still bearing that harmless expression. His energy was restrained almost beyond perception, a stark contrast to Ye Qing's blazing presence. The surrounding demonic disciples burst into laughter, all convinced the match's outcome was毫无悬念.

Yet only Ye Qing knew what kind of edge lay hidden deep within those seemingly timid eyes. That momentary gaze three days ago still haunted her—it wasn't the gaze atrash should possess. She suppressed her inner unease and said coldly: Are you ready?

dialogue.content: Anytime. Chen Ji's voice was terrifyingly calm. He slightly raised his right hand, fingertips凝聚一道 subdued spiritual light—that was deliberately suppressed on the surface. Yet in the Mental Sea invisible to others, the Heavenly Eye had quietly activated, capturing every trace of demonic energy flowing around Ye Qing.

text.content: Ye Qing launched a demonic forbidden technique without another word. Purple demonic light tore through the air, carrying destructive force aimed directly at Chen Ji's face. Yet Chen Ji merely sidestepped, and that seemingly inescapable attack whistled past his robes—precise, as if he had known its trajectory all along.

After missing once, a flash of astonishment crossed Ye Qing's eyes. She didn't pause, forming hand seals as her demonic cultivation operated at full strength. In an instant, dozens of demonic rays surged toward Chen Ji from all directions, sealing off all his escape routes. This was the Holy Sect of the Demonic Path's ultimate technique—Ten Thousand Demons Return to Origin!

Just as the demonic rays were about to engulf Chen Ji, he moved. Not to evade, but to charge forward! His form flickered like a specter穿梭于 the demonic rays, each step landing precisely in the gaps between attacks. Spectators saw only a blur darting left and right through the purple demonic sea, never touched by a single ray.

This... is impossible! Ye Qing's pupils contracted sharply. Ten Thousand Demons Return to Origin was her secret technique cultivated over many years—never missed, never so calmly countered. How could thistrash disciple possibly see through every ray's trajectory? Unless... Her heart chilled, a terrifying guess surfacing—He possesses some ability to foresee!

Chen Ji steadily advanced through the gaps in the demonic rays, drawing ever closer to Ye Qing. His expression remained tranquil, but deep in his eyes flickered dangerous light. The true killing move was just beginning. He silently gathered spiritual energy at his fingertips, preparing a lethal strike—aiming directly at three inches above the heart, that致命缺陷 in the demonic seed fusion!

dialogue.content: Die! Ye Qing roared, her demonic aura surging violently. She abandoned all restraint, pushing the Holy Sect's demonic techniques to the absolute limit. A ray of demonic energy far more terrifying than before burst forth. Yet the instant she struck, Chen Ji's lips curled into a cold smile—that moment! The demonic seed fusion point was fully exposed!

text.content: Chen Ji erupted forward, not retreating but advancing. As that world-destroying ray of demonic energy was about to strike him, he transformed into a streak of light, piercing directly toward three inches above Ye Qing's heart! His fingertips charged with spiritual energy precisely struck that fatal flaw only the Heavenly Eye could perceive—the Seed-Breaking Strike!

Boom! A muffled explosion echoed from within Ye Qing's body. Her complexion shifted drastically; the wild demonic energy within her suddenly destabilized and spiraled out of control. That was the demonic seed foundation she had cultivated for years, now struck at its critical point, violently rebelling against her meridians.

dialogue.content: How... how is this possible... Ye Qing's voice trembled with disbelief. Her legs buckled, one knee hitting the ground as she desperately braced herself to avoid collapsing. The demonic seed's backlash felt like countless insects gnawing at her organs, the excruciating pain rendering her almost incapable of thought. What on earth is happening?

text.content: Chen Ji slowly withdrew his hand, gazing down at the disheveled Ye Qing from above. His face betrayed no triumph, only a chilling stillness. Silence blanketed the surroundings; every demonic disciple was stunned—their supposedly invincible saint, brought to her knees by atrash disciple?

dialogue.content: Your demonic seed fusion isn't quite perfect, Saint Highness. Chen Ji's voice drifted lightly, yet struck Ye Qing like a sharp slap across the face. He slightly leaned in, whispering near her ear, his tone tender yet merciless: Did you think you were the only one who investigated me? In truth, my understanding of you might run deeper than your own self-knowledge.

text.content: Ye Qing jerked her head up, her eyes blazing with humiliation and defiance. She wanted to retort, but discovered she couldn't even stand. The demonic seed's backlash grew increasingly severe, each breath feeling like swallowing broken glass. Never before had she felt so degraded, so vividly threatened by death.

According to the bet, the insider list. Chen Ji's voice carried no emotion whatsoever. He extended his hand, palm facing upward, making a demanding gesture. The surrounding Demonic Path disciples looked at each other in hesitation, yet not one dared step forward to stop him—the scene from moments ago had been too shocking, and they were still doubting whether they were dreaming.

dialogue.content: You... Ye Qing gritted her teeth, a thread of blood trickling from the corner of her mouth. The Demonic Seed's backlash made even speaking a struggle, yet the hatred in her eyes was almost tangible. I'll remember you, Chen Ji! She drew a Jade Slip from her embrace and hurled it viciously at Chen Ji. Someday, I'll make you pay the price!

text.content: Chen Ji received the Jade Slip, his divine sense scanning it briefly, a satisfied curve forming at the corner of his lips. The insider list was in his hands, along with an unexpected bonus—the list contained fragments of the Holy Sect's core secrets. He tucked the Jade Slip into his robe and turned his gaze to Ye Qing, his eyes as cold and indifferent as looking at a dying ant.

Holy Maiden, tend to your injuries well—until we meet again. Chen Ji left these parting words and walked toward the barrier's edge without looking back. The surrounding Demonic Path disciples parted like water, none daring to impede his path. They watched his gaunt silhouette vanish from view, a singular realization dawning on each mind—this so-calledtrash disciple was far more terrifying than they had ever imagined.

Only when Chen Ji's form had completely vanished did Ye Qing stagger to her feet. Her face was deathly pale, the blood at the corner of her mouth a stark, jarring contrast. Two loyal disciples rushed to support her, but she shoved them away. Investigate! Investigate this Chen Ji thoroughly! Her voice was hoarse and savage—I want to know every detail about him!

Meanwhile, in a secluded cave dwelling far from the secret realm, Chen Ji sat cross-legged with the Tianji Record floating before him. He gazed at the flowing runes on the fragment, an uncommon gravity creasing his brow. Mo Xiansheng's voice drifted from the fragment: Well done, but the price... you should understand.

dialogue.content: Two consecutive uses of Heaven's Eye, combined with the strike that shattered the seed, have cost you nearly thirty percent of your Heavenly Fate. Mo Xiansheng's voice carried a note of warning: Ye Qing possesses a resolute spirit. Today's humiliation will be etched in her memory. She will not let this rest.

text.content: I know. Chen Ji's voice remained calm, though a rare softness flickered in his eyes. But she's worth it. The Holy Sect's insider list is merely the first move. A grander game still awaits. He tightened his grip on the Jade Slip, a meaningful smile playing at the corner of his lips. And this chess game's ultimate opponent... is far more terrifying than I had anticipated.

Mo Xiansheng fell silent for a moment, as if weighing his words. Finally, he sighed: You are more... ruthless than your father. Whether this is fortunate or catastrophic, even I cannot determine. As his words faded, the runes on the fragment dimmed, and Mo Xiansheng's voice dissipated into nothingness.

Chen Ji sat alone in the cave dwelling, turning the Jade Slip containing the insider list between his fingers. The depletion of his Heavenly Fate had indeed cost him some lifespan, yet this was all within his calculations. Beyond such ethereal lifespan concerns, what truly occupied his mind was the Holy Sect behind Ye Qing, and those eyes that had been watching him from the shadows.

Beyond the window, twilight deepened as the Demonic Path disciples within the secret realm tended to Ye Qing's wounds. Meanwhile, miles away at the Tianqing Sect, whispers of thetrash disciple Chen Ji's great triumph over the Demonic Path Holy Maiden in the secret realm were quietly spreading. This battle was destined to shake the entire cultivation world.
